title: Magic state cultivation on a superconducting quantum processor
authors: Rosenfeld, Gidney, Roberts, Morvan et al.
conversion_notes: Compare stim_X.stim and stim_Z.stim with accompanying cirq_circuit_X.json and cirq_circuit_Z.json to identify the replaced physical non-Clifford rotations and restore the actual rotations, including correct angles and conjugating H_YZ gates. Echo X gates are replaced by tagged identities in Stim; reconcile Pauli-frame changes when reconstructing the experimental circuit. Detectors and observables may no longer be deterministic.
notes: Author dataset explicitly documents Stim and Cirq circuits per experiment; fig2/fig3/fig4 archives are 733 MB to 1.6 GB each. Paper section VII provides interactive Crumble links for individual and full experimental circuits. README says Stim substitutes Clifford gates for non-Cliffords.

title: Scaling and logic in the color code on a superconducting quantum processor
conversion_notes: Experiment injects a magic state by preparing the injection data qubit and growing into a color code. Determine whether the injection circuit is included in the archive; if so, substitute the intended physical rotation for its Clifford preparation proxy.
notes: Stim official circuit references list this dataset, but Zenodo describes it specifically as memory experiments; inclusion of injection experiment circuits is not established. Archive 738 MB was not downloaded.

title: Magic State Injection on IBM Quantum Processors Above the Distillation Threshold
conversion_notes: Source capsule may allow reconstruction of the 25-qubit injection circuit; locate physical initialization qubit and replace its stabilizer-state preparation with the requested magic-state rotation. Stim output and exact conversion have not been verified.
notes: Experimental IBM work; paper says source code and data are available in Code Ocean, and describes use of Stim to generate circuits for simulation. Capsule contents and whether injection-specific Stim circuit is exposed have not been independently verified.

title: Architectural mechanisms of a universal fault-tolerant quantum computer
conversion_notes: For coherent-error experiments add the paper-specified global single-qubit rotations on data qubits between the corresponding stabilizer measurement time steps; map schedules and angles against raw experimental commands. Confirm simulator output is Stim before relying on it.
notes: Authors provide surface-code data and analysis and raw experimental commands. Independent repository reports a port of the released surface-code simulator; actual Stim emission and the correspondence to the coherent-rotation experiment remain unverified. Published title A fault-tolerant neutral-atom architecture for universal quantum computation.

title: Universal quantum computation via scalable measurement-free error correction
conversion_notes: Inspect released circuits and simulation code for the CCZ and disposable Toffoli gadgets; operation encoding and required conversion are not verified. This is a theoretical architecture rather than an experimental demonstration.
notes: Authors dataset states it includes simulated circuits and code; official Stim circuit catalog identifies Stim circuits. Paper describes logical CCZ and measurement-free Toffoli gadgets, but archive contents were not inspected.

title: Experimental demonstration of logical magic state distillation
authors: Sales Rodriguez, Robinson, Jepsen et al.
conversion_notes: Third-party benchmark includes a non-Clifford 85-qubit [17,1,5] distillation.stim; check its provenance and protocol against the experiment before calling it a reproduction. It uses an extended Stim-like dialect; verify angle units and simulator compatibility.
notes: The authors describe Stim-based simulations with non-magic entangled input and separate Qiskit ideal magic-state inputs, but author-released circuit code was not located. Third-party 85-qubit circuit is merely a possible related workload, not established as the experiment circuit; repository describes native extended-dialect non-Clifford gates but exact gate content of distillation file not independently checked.
